image_description: A street scene featuring a traditional May Day celebration. A tall green pole (maypole) stands in the center, adorned with a floral wreath at the top and colorful ribbons extending downwards. Several dancers in traditional Morris dancing attire (white shirts, black vests/breeches, bells on legs) are holding the ribbons and weaving around the pole. The background consists of brick buildings with shop fronts, including one labeled 'BOOKS'. Bunting flags hang across the street above.
